title: Goods and trade
note: B1 Oxford-gap leaf · making and moving goods, then selling them · 12 items · carriers via use[] · picture intro · Use bank

intro.title: How things reach the shop
intro.title_cz: Jak se zboží dostane do obchodu
intro.body:
You already know how to buy something. This unit is about everything that had to happen first — the factory, the ship, the van at the door, and the shelf it finally lands on.
The first six follow the journey from the maker to your street. The last six are what happens at the other end, where somebody has to persuade you to pick that shelf and not the next one.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: export and import are opposite directions of the same journey: you export out of your country and import into it. Czech keeps the pair just as tidily — vyvážet and dovážet — so the prefix does the work in both languages.
intro.note_cz: export = vyvážet (ven ze země), import = dovážet (do země).
